title: How do climate scientists make predictions?
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
Why can climate scientists make useful predictions even when they cannot know the exact future?
What is the difference between a forecast, a projection, and a scenario in your understanding?
How should scientists communicate uncertainty without making the public think they know nothing?
Why do people sometimes demand more certainty from climate science than from other areas of decision-making?
What would make you trust a long-term climate prediction more?
